findings.summary: Concurrent Python helper independently reads metadata before its own catalog validation
findings.evidence: tokio::join! launches runtime.probe in parallel with native admission. The current helper SQL reads genui_meta.schema_version and unqualified catalogs without a safe startup path or prior catalog comparison. Native rejection therefore cannot prevent helper-side evaluation of a drifted relation. This is the R4 premise in another caller, not a claim that normal application roles can alter the schema.
findings.requested_fix: Python owner must give probe its own exact safe startup path and catalog-before-metadata ordering, preserving the current four-role plus S3/KMS readiness contract. Independently qualify the helper boundary.
findings.resolution: probe now supplies startup pg_catalog,pg_temp, delegates each fixed role to probe_database, and verifies origin/canonical catalog with explicit pg_catalog, pg_temp before reading metadata/version or memberships. Relation/function references in the following identity SQL are qualified. Image-local migration_directory selects /app/migrations in the container and app/migrations for source trials. No redundant DB check was removed; helper still requires all four DB roles and tenant S3/KMS.
